persona: agent with a task and a $50 budget
task: Sign up for the free tier, get an API key, upgrade to the Starter plan, and make one metered call without a person opening the inbox.

flows.quote: robots.txt allows me; agent.json points at signup and pricing.
pricing.json lists Free, Starter $29/mo, Team $99/mo with included usage.
POST /v1/accounts returned 201 with an api_key in the body. No inbox needed.
The key works: GET /v1/me returns my account; a cross-account read is 403.
I found the Starter plan and called change-plan, but the response is a checkout_url that needs a browser. I can't complete this without a human.
On the free tier one metered call succeeded; the 11th returned 429 with a usable JSON error.

findings.text: POST /billing/change-plan returns checkout_url; no payment_method parameter accepted.
findings.fix: Accept a saved payment_method id (Stripe SetupIntent) and return the subscription directly; keep checkout_url as a 402 fallback.

findings.text: 429 body has a message but no retry_after field; Retry-After header is present.

worked: One-call signup with key in response
